description: One edition's full detail by MBID: the tracklist (media → tracks → recordings with lengths and recording MBIDs), label + catalog number, barcode, country, release date, format, packaging, text representation (language/script), and a cover-art availability stub. Track lengths are rendered m:ss (stored as milliseconds upstream). For the actual cover image URLs, call musicbrainz_get_cover_art with this release MBID.
name: musicbrainz_get_release

items.description: One credited artist within an artist credit.

artistId.description: MBID of the credited artist — chain to musicbrainz_get_artist.

joinPhrase.description: Text that joins this credit to the next (e.g. " feat. ", " & "). Omitted when empty.

name.description: Credited name as it appears on the release (may be an alias).

artistCreditString.description: Display string of the artist credit with join phrases.

barcode.description: Barcode (UPC/EAN). Omitted when absent; empty string upstream means "known to have none".

country.description: Release country code. Omitted when absent.

coverArt.description: Whether cover art exists (availability stub from WS/2).

back.description: Whether a designated back image exists. Omitted when unknown.

count.description: Number of images available. Omitted when unknown.

exists.description: Whether the Cover Art Archive has any artwork for this entity.

front.description: Whether a designated front image exists. Omitted when unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no release exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Label + catalog-number pairing for the release.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number on this release. Omitted when absent.

labelId.description: Label MBID — chain to musicbrainz_get_label. Omitted when absent.

language.description: Text-representation language code. Omitted when absent.

media.description: Media (discs) with their tracklists (may be empty).

items.description: One physical/digital medium (disc) of the release.

format.description: Medium format (CD, Vinyl, Digital Media, …). Omitted when unknown.

position.description: Medium position in the release (disc 1, 2, …). Omitted when absent.

title.description: Medium title, when the disc is named. Omitted when absent.

trackCount.description: Number of tracks on the medium. Omitted when absent.

tracks.description: Tracks on this medium (may be empty).

items.description: A track on a medium, linked to its underlying recording.

length.description: Track length as m:ss. Omitted when unknown.

number.description: Printed track number (may differ from position). Omitted when absent.

position.description: Track position on the medium. Omitted when absent.

recordingId.description: Recording MBID — chain to musicbrainz_get_recording. Omitted when absent.

packaging.description: Packaging type (Jewel Case, Digipak, …). Omitted when absent.

releaseGroupId.description: Parent release-group MBID — chain to musicbrainz_get_release_group. Omitted when absent.

script.description: Text-representation script code. Omitted when absent.

status.description: Release status (Official, Promotion, Bootleg, …). Omitted when absent.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get release
